item.title: Road markings have worn away, 17th August
item.description:
The road markings at this junction have disappeared. Andrew Bashford told me he was looking at this but unsurprisingly nothing has happened and he didn't have the decency to come back to me. Since my report there has been a serious accident at the junction (look at the house on the corner) and the police sent a report highlighting that the roadmarkings need repainting.......what on earth needs to happen for something to happen here? Maybe you are waiting for someone to be killed. I have previously reported this on Fixmystreet
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sherwood Road, Falconwood, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Public urinating, 17th August
item.description:
There is a longstanding issue of members of the public using this road as a place to urinate, mainly against the walls of the school and against the building (1A Peckham High Street). This has been happening for months, maybe even years on a regular basis. This is causing issues as, it’s extremely unpleasant to witness, extremely unhygienic and the smell is now drifting into the flats above when the windows are open. Can the street please be cleaned and maintained on a regular basis as it is really horrible to live on. Thanks

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Peckham Road, Peckham, Greater London
